verification.method: Research brief 2026-09-15 (press: Digital Music News, Quartz 2026-09-09; guides: HookGenius, Blake Crosley, SongSmith, usesuno.com, sunometatagcreator) plus the Jinn v1.2 renders. Suno publishes no official limits table or tag list; app-side numbers can shift between UI releases and must be checked in the live composer before each build.
verified: v6 launched 2026-09-09 as v6 and v6-wild (Pro/Premier) and v6-mini (all users); v5 and v4.5 removed from the picker
Style field ~1,000 chars; Lyrics 5,000; Title 100 in the app (80 via API); Exclude Styles maxlength 1,000 under Custom Mode → Advanced Options
Instrumental toggle ON: bracket tags in Lyrics are read as directions, not sung; structure control survives the toggle
Exclude Styles is more reliable than inline 'no X' in Style
BPM in the prompt is guidance, not a lock; renders drift; Suno Studio → Manual BPM conforms stems to a fixed grid
Artist names in Style are flagged or stripped
community: Front-loaded tags carry more weight than later ones
No official time-signature tag; '[4/4]' style meta-tags are community conventions
Drift words toward compound/odd feels: shuffle, swing, triplet feel, waltz, rubato, trance, folk rhythm names in 6/8, 9/8, 10/8
Practical Lyrics sweet spot ~3,000 chars before the model rushes

fields.label: Style
fields.notes: Physics and palette in priority order: form/meter/tempo, key/mode, drum grammar, regional instruments and their 4/4 rhythms, synth roles, textures, transition rule, bridge and finale in one clause each, mood, inline negation last.

fields.label: Exclude Styles
fields.notes: Custom Mode → Advanced Options. Four classes in order: vocals/lyrics, meter drift, genre bleed, instrument ambiguity; then custom.

fields.label: Lyrics
fields.notes: The timeline. One bracket per section carrying, in order: section name, drum state, bass/808 state, lead, texture, transition/FX, pocket. Pickup bars and silence drops are their own brackets. Contrast phrases are labelled and bounded inside the section bracket. Passthrough lyrics only when Instrumental is OFF.

toggles.label: Instrumental
toggles.effect: ON: Lyrics brackets are read as arrangement directions and not sung; keep Lyrics to structure tags only. OFF: Lyrics are sung; brackets still shape sections.

driftWordsNote: Assembled from the v1.1 → v1.2 failure (render slipped into 6/8 and odd-length passages). 'triplet' alone is allowed for hat rolls ('32nd rolls with triplet fills') but flagged when paired with 'feel' or 'shuffle'; drop 'triplet hats' first if drift appears.
bannedTermsNote: Artist and producer names are flagged or stripped by Suno (verified 2026-09-15); no public list. EVAWAVE's lineage pass strips them before serialization regardless, so this list stays empty.
aliasesNote: Suno may read bare 'tabla' as the Indian pair; the alias plus Exclude entries for sitar/Bollywood hold the line. The drift fallback swaps to 'darbuka' everywhere on the rerun.

supportsNotes.D3: Dynamics only as words inside brackets; no numeric control.
supportsNotes.D6: BPM is guidance; no meter tag; key/mode as prose. Meter lock is prose plus Exclude plus the post-render Manual BPM step.
supportsNotes.D7: Bracket tags read as directions with Instrumental ON (verified). Bar counts are not honoured; runtime is approximate.
supportsNotes.D10: Exclude Styles field is the reliable negative channel.

houseBudgetsNote: Jinn v1.2 rule: ≤3,000 characters across the three pasted fields keeps the model from rushing.
postRender: Suno Studio → Manual BPM = <Form.tempo> to hard-lock the grid before stems reach the DAW.
Export stems; hand the word-MIDI blueprint to the DAW session for reconstruction or repair.
Generate 4–6 takes. Keep the take where Hook and Bridge are audibly different sections and the Hook B lead is present. Kill any take that lands in a major key or skips the drums-out bridge.
If a take stops before the finale, use Extend from the Bridge with the same Style text.

repairRules.symptom: render drifts to 6/8 or odd-length passages
repairRules.action: Swap 'tabla' → 'darbuka' everywhere, remove 'zar rhythm' from the Verse bracket, keep the meter lock text first in Style, rerun.
Strip brackets to bare tags ([Intro], [Build], [Hook]...) and rerun; if vocals persist, Instrumental ON and rely on Style alone (loses section control, keeps palette).
Apply the drift-fallback alias, confirm 'sitar, Bollywood' are in Exclude, rerun.
Manual BPM in Suno Studio; not a prompt problem.
